interpretationRules: An inscribed year is recorded as an exact year but may date only the relevant component or rebuilding phase.
A century or part-century description is stored as a range and labelled as estimated where appropriate.
Where published sources disagree, the range preserves both and the conflict is recorded.
Conservation-area dates refer to designation, not building construction.
A listing date is not substituted for a construction date.
